name: Moonlight
source:
This story follows Van, a hunter who has a chance encounter with a creature unlike any they’ve ever faced, that will cause Van to question everything they have ever known about monsters.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
这个故事讲述了猎人范的故事，他偶然遇到了一种他们从未遇到过的生物，这让范开始质疑他们对怪物的了解。

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用程序[/url]]
